An ...... defines how software systems communicate through specific endpoints, requests, and responses. It gives applications a structured way to access data or trigger functionality in another system.
...... gives AI applications a standardized way to discover and use external tools, data, and resources. Instead of building custom integrations for every AI client, an MCP server exposes capabilities through a common protocol.
MCP doesn't replace APIs. Most MCP servers wrap them.
APIs expose the service. MCP makes it usable by a model. Or a human. The barrier to entry for non-technical people to interact with platforms has been drastically reduced.
But once a model decides what to call, the work it does gets harder to track.
Agents finish tasks without status updates while people shift priorities. Permissions limit what an agent can touch, but they don't show whether its work still matches the strategy that funded it.
